# 1 Introduction

This document specifies the Orders API, released on 2024-04-01.

## 1.1 Scope

The API must respond within 2 seconds.

# 2 Operations

2.1 Create an order
A request may create at most 100 orders.

2.2 Cancel an order
Only orders created under 2.1 can be cancelled.
2.5 days is the longest a cancellation may take.
